contradictions.why: In A, the narrator's gaze is lowered by an external force (the situation/shame), whereas in B, the narrator actively lowers his own gaze.
A suggests spending/losing money for the sake of memory, while B suggests removing/losing the money permanently as a lesson.

omissions.a: وَكَانَ أَصْحَابُكَ مَا أَصَابَكَ تَتَذَكَّرْ أَبَدًا مَا دَهَاكَ

additions.b: ويؤكد المعلق أن ضياع المال ثمن بخس في مقابل الحكمة المكتسبة من لقاء المحتال أبي زيد.
